title: v1.109.0
excerpt: Verify this release cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0 Same command for litellm-database , litellm-non_root and the docker.io/litellm/* images What's new in 1.109.0 982 PRs. 144 added, 424 fixed, 60 changed, 17 improved, 9 removed. 5 need action Action required Routing and fallbacks: Change string fallback targets to lists of model names ( #48943 ) Caching: Switch cache_params.type from disk to local or redis , since the disk cache backend (diskcache) has been removed ( #48114 ) Routing and fallbacks: Add optional_pre_call_checks: ["enforce_model_rate_limits"] to keep a hard rpm cap on deployments ( #48873 ) Vertex AI and Gemini: Set drop_params: true or stop sending temperature , top_p and top_k to Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and newer ( #47645 ) Deployment: Deploy Lens from its own chart and set lens.* in your values ( #49169 ) Highlights Admin UI: Added a Chat UI with a model hub, image generation and usage metrics ( #48108 ) Routing and fallbacks: Added mid-stream fallback continuation so a streaming chat cut off mid-answer continues on the configured fallback ( #41127 ) Deployment: Added LITELLM_OFFLINE_MODE to turn off every fetch LiteLLM makes on its own with one switch ( #48096 ) Cost tracking and pricing: Added model_info.pricing_provider to price a deployment from another provider's catalog rates instead of $0 ( #47620 ) Vertex AI and Gemi
